records.description: Primary Activity Selection v1.3 selects which WorkMap activities enter Runtime 40/20; Method Kernel validates method conformance of PM, MoC, PF and OLC after evidence exists.
records.recommendation: Keep selection authority in v1.3. Method Kernel must not select, rank or reselect activities.

records.description: The selector already owns competitive selection, reentry for no eligible activities and non-primary context preservation.
records.recommendation: Use Method Kernel only after selected activity evidence is available; do not call it from selection scoring.

records.description: Method Kernel declares readiness states and an execution pipeline, while Runtime 40/20 already owns runtime budget, readiness and block catalog authority.
records.recommendation: Rename Method Kernel readiness as methodological readiness or map it explicitly to Runtime readiness without replacing Runtime gates.

records.description: The chip can block or request reentry, which may conflict with Runtime 40/20 readiness/reentry if wired as an executable gate too early.
records.recommendation: Before wiring, define a one-way boundary: Method Kernel emits advisory conformance status; Runtime remains final execution gate.

records.description: FND-007 and FND-008 use D4 as boundary source for epistemology/readiness. This is acceptable as boundary language but risky if it becomes runtime execution logic.
records.recommendation: Keep D4/D5 references as compatibility boundaries only; add explicit no-runtime-gate wording.

records.description: FND-008 says outputs must pass candidates, conformance, consistency and readiness before registry, IR, export or Produccion Paralela; this touches runtime output contract territory.
records.recommendation: Constrain FND-008 to methodological precondition language and leave concrete runtime output gates to Runtime 40/20.

records.description: Runtime B0 captures semantic preload, confirmation, operational description and readiness effects. Method Kernel needs evidence but should not replace B0 capture.
records.recommendation: Method Kernel may consume B0 evidence records only after B0 completes; it must not define B0 questions or UI.

records.description: The adapter converts B0 catalog records into interaction view models. Method Kernel is a methodological validator, not an adapter.
records.recommendation: No direct wiring to adapter in this phase.

records.description: WorkMap Writing Assistance is documented-not-wired and supports responsibility/activity wording. Method Kernel validates model conformance later.
records.recommendation: Do not use Method Kernel to alter WorkMap copy assistance or H12 coverage-only behavior.

records.description: The WorkMap audit explicitly says no runtimeAuthority and no executable validator. Method Kernel should not reinterpret it as runtime authority.
records.recommendation: Keep both artifacts separate; Method Kernel cannot certify WorkMap chip wiring.

records.description: Operational description canon shapes literal activity description and may provide evidence consumed by Method Kernel.
records.recommendation: Method Kernel may validate downstream model candidates, but must not rewrite ASRO wording rules.

records.description: The executable canon owns operational description structure. Method Kernel's evidence requirements could be confused with ASRO capture requirements.
records.recommendation: Map evidence fields explicitly before wiring; do not add kernel blockers into the description assistant.

records.description: Document Transduction QA governs fidelity states and source mapping. Method Kernel is itself subject to that policy.
records.recommendation: Apply QA policy to Method Kernel package before any runtimeAuthority registration.

records.description: The policy code classifies transduction status; Method Kernel should not duplicate that classifier.
records.recommendation: Use the policy as external governance, not as a rule inside Method Kernel.

records.description: Registering this chip as runtimeAuthority would imply executable authority while D1 is missing and package inconsistencies remain.
records.recommendation: Do not register runtimeAuthority. Keep candidate not wired until source and package issues are resolved.

records.description: The package says pathology hints are null and diagnostic output is disabled in stage 00. This is internally aligned, but future wiring could let blocker states look like diagnostic conclusions.
records.recommendation: Use neutral methodological statuses only; do not emit pathology labels or diagnostic ontology from this chip.

records.description: FND-008 mentions Produccion Paralela as downstream consumer boundary.
records.recommendation: Keep this as a precondition statement only. The chip must not execute, orchestrate or export Produccion Paralela.
